entries.0c0b3afc821f55da: Because the Resources Business accounts for about 72% of revenue, the structure is such that the expansion of commissioned treatment of construction waste in the Tokyo metropolitan area determines the growth of the group as a whole. entries.bbeae1656b0a8019: Under the corporate philosophy of aiming to “create new industries as a materials recycling company and contribute to the sustainable development of society,” the company states that it will create businesses that run counter to conventional flows (ＩＮＶＥＲＳＥ) by regenerating products that were previously discarded (ＲＥＦＩＮＥ). As priority issues to address, it lists stable securing of industrial waste as raw material for the Materials Business, expansion of sales volume, improvement of selling prices, strengthening of cost competitiveness, and entry into new business areas. As a new business, it began its polyolefin recycling business in February 2026 and states that it has completed preparations to supply raw materials for oil-based chemical recycling and materials for material recycling.
